text: One of the great secrets to life is protecting your mindset. You really need to remove everything that makes you feel less powerful and that makes you think negatively. It doesn't matter if that's a belief system, if that's a certain friend, if that's a girl, if that's a a bad job you hate, anything that makes you feel less powerful, anything that makes you doom, you know, doomerism, thinking negatively, you have to remove it from your life completely. [music] You need to start forcing yourself to think positively and to be delusional and to protect your mindset and your confidence at all cost, at all [music] cost.
